config.label: Google Ads API developer token from your Google Ads Manager account
config.description: Google Ads API developer token from your Google Ads Manager account. Required.

config.label: Google OAuth2 client secret
config.description: Google OAuth2 client secret. Prefer storing in ~/.google-ads-mcp/config.json via setup.

config.label: Manager (MCC) customer ID used as login-customer-id header, no dashes (e
config.description: Manager (MCC) customer ID used as login-customer-id header, no dashes (e.g., 1234567890). Optional but required for multi-account access.

config.label: OAuth redirect URI
config.description: OAuth redirect URI. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3000/callback.

config.label: Optional local path for OAuth tokens
config.description: Optional local path for OAuth tokens. Defaults to ~/.google-ads-mcp/tokens.json (0600).

config.label: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw
config.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured. raw returns full Google Ads API payloads.

config.label: Set to true to enable write tools (pause/resume keywords/campaigns, set bids, set budgets)
config.description: Set to true to enable write tools (pause/resume keywords/campaigns, set bids, set budgets). Default false (read-only). Agents changing real ad spend is high-stakes; review every change.

config.label: Optional SQLite cache toggle
config.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

config.label: Optional local SQLite cache path
config.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.google-ads-mcp/cache.sqlite.

config.label: Optional cache TTL in seconds
config.description: Optional cache TTL in seconds. Defaults to 60. Set to 0 to keep entries indefinitely (entries are still overwritten on each hit).

config.label: Set to true to disable the HTTP retry middleware
config.description: Set to true to disable the HTTP retry middleware. Default false.
